answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases as a result burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the sable deposit is held in the canyon escrow, the spiral audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 54 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
